Let the cycle vertices be indexed modulo \(13\), and write
\[
C_{ij}=4\min(|i-j|,13-|i-j|)
\]
for the cycle distance matrix at \(p=1\). At \(s=0\),
\[
d_0(\ast,i)=(7,7,7,11,15,13,17,21,23,19,15,15,11)_i.
\]

The equality vector is determined by
\[
Da=\lambda \mathbf 1,\qquad \sum_z a_z=0,\qquad a_\ast=2.
\]
Solving gives \(\lambda=2\) and
\[
(a_0,\ldots,a_{12})
=(-2,1,0,0,2,-2,-2,0,2,0,0,1,-2).
\]
Thus
\[
a=(2;-2,1,0,0,2,-2,-2,0,2,0,0,1,-2).
\]

For the cycle matrix \(C\), the nonconstant Fourier eigenvalues are
\[
8\sum_{k=1}^{6}k\cos\frac{2\pi mk}{13}
=-\frac{4}{1-\cos(2\pi m/13)}<0,
\]
so \(C\) is negative definite on the zero-sum subspace. Since \(Da=2\mathbf 1\), every zero-sum vector decomposes into the null direction \(a\) plus a cycle zero-sum part, proving \(1\)-negative type at \(s=0\). But
\[
\left.\frac{d}{dp}\right|_{p=1}\sum_{z,w}a_za_wd_0(z,w)^p=4\tau>0,
\]
so \(p>1\) immediately violates negative type. Therefore
\[
\wp(0)=1.
\]

Now compute \(\tau\). Grouping equal distances in
\[
\sum_{z,w}a_za_wd_0(z,w)\log d_0(z,w)
\]
gives coefficients
\[
\begin{array}{c|rrrrrrrrrrr}
d&7&8&11&12&13&15&16&17&20&23&24\\
\hline
\text{coeff}&-28&-192&-88&24&-104&180&-192&-136&-320&184&672.
\end{array}
\]
Hence
\[
\tau
=\log\!\left(
\frac{2^{20}3^{219}23^{46}}
{5^{35}7^7 11^{22}13^{26}17^{34}}
\right).
\]

For \(|s|<1/2\), the same shortest paths from \(\ast\) remain active. Write
\[
f(s)=(d_s(\ast,0),\ldots,d_s(\ast,12)).
\]
At \(p=1\), maximize
\[
Q_s(x)=x^TCx+4f(s)^Tx,\qquad \sum_i x_i=-2,
\]
corresponding to \(a_\ast=2\). The optimizer has expansion
\[
x(s)=x_0+sx_1+s^2x_2,
\]
where
\[
x_0=(-2,1,0,0,2,-2,-2,0,2,0,0,1,-2),
\]
\[
x_1=(0,\tfrac12,0,0,-\tfrac12,0,0,0,\tfrac12,0,0,-\tfrac12,0),
\]
\[
x_2=(0,-\tfrac1{12},0,0,\tfrac1{12},0,0,0,-\tfrac1{12},0,0,\tfrac1{12},0).
\]
Substitution gives
\[
\max Q_s=\frac{s^4}{18}+O(s^5).
\]
Since the \(p\)-derivative of the same optimized quadratic at \((s,p)=(0,1)\) is \(4\tau\), the boundary equation is
\[
0=\frac{s^4}{18}+4\tau(\wp(s)-1)+O(s^5),
\]
so
\[
\wp''''(0)=-\frac{1}{3\tau}.
\]
Therefore
\[
\xi=\tau\,\wp''''(0)=-\frac13.
\]

\[
\boxed{
\left(
1,\,
\log\!\left(
\frac{2^{20}3^{219}23^{46}}
{5^{35}7^7 11^{22}13^{26}17^{34}}
\right),\,
-\frac13
\right)
}
\]
